name: PLAY-publish v1 (multi-app)

parameters.command: ={{ 'CI_OWNER=play CI_DEFAULT_BRANCH=imperium CI_BRANCH=' + JSON.stringify($json.app_id || 'imperium') + ' sh -c "echo  | base64 -d > /tmp/codice-ci-mutex.js && node /tmp/codice-ci-mutex.js acquire"' }}

={{ 'set -euo pipefail
APP_ID=' + JSON.stringify(String($('Normalize payload').first().json.app_id || '')) + '
PKG=' + JSON.stringify(String($('Normalize payload').first().json.package_name || '')) + '
TRACK=' + JSON.stringify(String($('Normalize payload').first().json.track || 'closed')) + '
STATUS=' + JSON.stringify(String($('Normalize payload').first().json.status || 'completed')) + '
DRY=' + JSON.stringify(String($('Normalize payload').first().json.dry_run || '0')) + '
AAB=' + JSON.stringify(String($('Normalize payload').first().json.aab_path || '')) + '
SA=' + JSON.stringify(String($('Normalize payload').first().json.sa_path || '')) + '
' + "# Host bind-mounts via docker.sock. n8n does NOT have /home/deploy/secrets,
# so never test -d those paths here - that wrongly fell back to IMPERIUM
# and Docvat AAB failed with: release keystore not found at /secrets/docvat-upload.jks.
if [ "$APP_ID" = "docvat" ]; then
  SECRETS_MOUNT="${DOCVAT_SECRETS_MOUNT:-/home/deploy/secrets/docvat:/secrets:ro}"
else
  SECRETS_MOUNT="${IM_SECRETS_MOUNT:-/home/deploy/secrets/imperium:/secrets:ro}"
fi
echo "==> Play secrets mount APP_ID=$APP_ID -> $SECRETS_MOUNT"
SOCK_GID=$(stat -c %g /var/run/docker.sock)

if [ ! -f /tmp/codice-ci-mutex.js ]; then
  echo "WARN: mutex.js missing on n8n /tmp (heartbeat skipped)"
fi
(
  while true; do
    [ -f /tmp/codice-ci-mutex.js ] && CI_OWNER=play node /tmp/codice-ci-mutex.js heartbeat >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
    sleep 60
  done
) &
HB=$!
cleanup_hb() { kill "$HB" 2>/dev/null || true; }
trap cleanup_hb EXIT INT TERM

EXTRA_VOLS=""
if [ "$APP_ID" = "docvat" ]; then
  docker volume inspect codice-progressio_n8n_gradle >/dev/null 2>&1 || docker volume create codice-progressio_n8n_gradle
  docker volume inspect codice-progressio_n8n_android_sdk >/dev/null 2>&1 || docker volume create codice-progressio_n8n_android_sdk
  docker volume inspect codice-progressio_n8n_yarn >/dev/null 2>&1 || docker volume create codice-progressio_n8n_yarn
  EXTRA_VOLS="-v codice-progressio_n8n_gradle:/cache/gradle -v codice-progressio_n8n_android_sdk:/work/docvat/frontend/.android-build-tools -v codice-progressio_n8n_yarn:/cache/yarn"
  if [ ! -f /tmp/repo/docvat/scripts/package-aab.sh ]; then
    echo "==> cloning Documentos Vaticanos (no checkout for AAB)"
    mkdir -p /tmp/repo
    rm -rf /tmp/repo/docvat
    git clone --depth 1 --branch "${DOCVAT_BRANCH:-typescript-migration}" --single-branch \
      https://github.com/RafaelAngelRamirez/documentos-vaticanos.git /tmp/repo/docvat
    git -C /tmp/repo/docvat fetch --tags --force origin || true
  fi
  echo "==> Docvat checkout $(git -C /tmp/repo/docvat log -1 --oneline 2>/dev/null || echo n/a)"
fi

set +e
docker run --rm --network codice-progressio_default \
  --user 1000:1000 --group-add "$SOCK_GID" \
  -v /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock \
  -v codice-progressio_n8n_build:/work \
  -v ${SECRETS_MOUNT} \
  $EXTRA_VOLS \
  -e HOME=/cache/gradle/.home_runner \
  -e GRADLE_USER_HOME=/cache/gradle \
  -e YARN_CACHE_FOLDER=/cache/yarn \
  -e PLAY_PACKAGE_NAME="$PKG" \
  -e PLAY_TRACK="$TRACK" \
  -e PLAY_STATUS="$STATUS" \
  -e PLAY_DRY_RUN="$DRY" \
  -e PLAY_AAB_PATH="$AAB" \
  -e PLAY_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON="$SA" \
  -e PLAY_META_PATH="$(dirname "$AAB")/aab.meta.txt" \
  -e DV_KEYSTORE_PATH="${DV_KEYSTORE_PATH:-/secrets/docvat-upload.jks}" \
  -e DV_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD="${DV_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD:-}" \
  -e DV_KEY_ALIAS="${DV_KEY_ALIAS:-docvat-upload}" \
  -e DV_KEY_PASSWORD="${DV_KEY_PASSWORD:-}" \
  -e DV_PACKAGE_NAME="${DV_PACKAGE_NAME:-com.docvat}" \
  -e JAVA_HOME=/usr/lib/jvm/temurin-21-jdk-amd64 \
  -e APP_ID="$APP_ID" \
  -w /work \
  imperium-build-runner:latest \
  bash -lc '
    set -euo pipefail
    if [[ "${APP_ID}" == "docvat" ]]; then
      if [[ ! -f /work/docvat/scripts/package-aab.sh ]]; then
        echo "ERROR: missing /work/docvat checkout" >&2
        exit 2
      fi
      if [[ ! -f "${PLAY_AAB_PATH}" ]]; then
        echo "==> packaging Docvat AAB (missing ${PLAY_AAB_PATH})"
        cd /work/docvat
        bash scripts/package-aab.sh
      else
        echo "==> reusing existing AAB ${PLAY_AAB_PATH}"
      fi
      if [[ ! -f "${PLAY_AAB_PATH}" ]]; then
        echo "ERROR: AAB still missing after package-aab" >&2
        exit 2
      fi
      if ! ( cd /work/docvat && node -e "require(\"googleapis\")" ) 2>/dev/null; then
        echo "==> installing googleapis into /work/docvat"
        ( cd /work/docvat && npm install googleapis@^144.0.0 --no-save --no-fund --no-audit ) || true
      fi
      if [[ -f /work/docvat/scripts/play-upload-closed.js ]]; then
        node /work/docvat/scripts/play-upload-closed.js
      elif [[ -f /work/scripts/play/play-upload.js ]]; then
        node /work/scripts/play/play-upload.js
      else
        echo "ERROR: no play-upload script for docvat" >&2
        exit 2
      fi
    else
      if [[ -f /work/scripts/play/play-upload.js ]]; then
        node /work/scripts/play/play-upload.js
      elif [[ -f /work/imperium/scripts/play/play-upload.js ]]; then
        node /work/imperium/scripts/play/play-upload.js
      else
        echo "ERROR: no play-upload script on volume" >&2
        exit 2
      fi
    fi
  '
rc=$?
set -e
cleanup_hb
trap - EXIT INT TERM
if [ "$rc" -eq 0 ] && [ "$APP_ID" = "docvat" ]; then
  rm -f /tmp/codice-ci-pending-docvat-play.json
fi
if [ "$rc" -ne 0 ]; then
  echo "ERROR: Play publish failed rc=$rc" >&2
  exit "$rc"
fi
echo "::PLAY_PUBLISH_DONE::$PKG"
" }}

CI_OWNER=play CI_FAILED=0 sh -c 'echo  | base64 -d > /tmp/codice-ci-mutex.js && node /tmp/codice-ci-mutex.js release'

parameters.text: ={{ "📱 Empieza Play Store de " + ($json.app_id === "docvat" ? "Documentos Vaticanos" : "IMPERIUM") + " (" + $json.package_name + ")\nPista: " + $json.track + " · estado: " + $json.status + ($json.app_id === "docvat" ? "\nSi falta el AAB, se empaqueta ahora (en cola, no corta IMPERIUM)." : "") }}

={{ (() => { const j = $json || {}; const out = String(j.stdout || "") + "
" + String(j.stderr || ""); const ok = /::PLAY_PUBLISH_DONE::|::DOCVAT_PLAY_UPLOAD_OK::|LISTO/.test(out) && Number(j.exitCode || 0) === 0; const app = ($("Normalize payload").first().json.app_id === "docvat") ? "Documentos Vaticanos" : "IMPERIUM"; if (ok) return "✅ Play Store de " + app + " listo.
" + (out.match(/::PLAY_PUBLISH_DONE::\S+/) || out.match(/::DOCVAT_PLAY_UPLOAD_OK::\S+/) || ["subida OK"])[0]; const first = out.split(/?
/).map(l => l.trim()).filter(l => /ERROR|error:|failed|403|PERMISSION/.test(l)).slice(-4).join(" | "); return "❌ Play Store de " + app + " falló.
" + (first || "ver log n8n"); })() }}

description: Play Store multi-app (IMPERIUM + Documentos Vaticanos). Holder=play priority 30 - waits behind IMPERIUM web and Docvat web. Docvat: packages AAB if missing then uploads com.docvat (closed/completed). NO wipe of shared volume. Webhook POST /webhook/play-publish {app_id}.
